on_failure: Preserve evidence and return to design, including infrastructure failures. No ordinary CI retry authority.

module_fetch.accounting: Fetched HTTP response BODY bytes as received before decoding, including every redirect, error, truncated and failed response. Headers/TLS/TCP excluded. Sequential, no retries.
module_fetch.overflow: Check Content-Length before body reads. Read at most remaining+1; count the observed overflow byte, preserve partial file/receipt, fail the single attempt.
module_fetch.go_archive_accounting: Outside module counter. Final Go archive capped at exact pinned size+1 and exact size/hash. All Go HTTP bodies also remain inside the separate accepted128MiB compiler-archive transfer ceiling.
module_fetch.info_necessity: Pinned Go1.27.3 modcmd.DownloadModule calls InfoFile for each downloaded zip version before GoModFile/DownloadZip. Freeze only exact .info versions with zip entries in pinned go.sum.

compiler_identity.basis: This build's own accepted first-observed trusted-host rule under6419297367, not decoder hash-rule inheritance.
compiler_identity.CXX_choice: b: strict nominal clang++ -> exact canonical clang, and canonical clang -> itself; no other tool alias.
compiler_identity.SDK_relation: Fixed SDKROOT must strictly resolve to itself. No versioned SDK alias query/adoption.
compiler_identity.pre_post: Canonical paths and alias relation, first hashes/versions/SDK metadata before transfers; same fixed-file hashes and relations after signing before artifact acceptance.

build.offline: Only file://<volume>/proxy. Fresh GOMODCACHE/GOCACHE/GOPATH, pinned unchanged go.mod/go.sum, readonly flags, no sumdb/VCS/private/direct fallback. Missing frozen request fails; no replenishment.
build.verification: go mod download -json (no extra module queries), go mod verify before/after build; preserve modules/raw metadata and unchanged sums. Configuration is not a claim that Go opened no sockets.

volume.hard_cap: Mounted volume logical capacity <=12GiB including filesystem metadata, with ENOSPC. UDRW fixed non-sparse image, not SPARSE/SPARSEBUNDLE. Source, archive/toolchain/proxy/all caches/HOME/TMP/output/signing files inside.
volume.reserve: Immediately after create/attach and before any payload fetch: backing filesystem user-available bytes >=4GiB + max(0, backing logical bytes - allocated blocks*512). Initial provisioned reserve only, not a live floor.
outside_writers: controller receipts and bounded evidence export
volume.failure: No root/sudo/FUSE/helpers/quota/broker/proxy service/VM or alternate volume. Creation/attach/detach/ENOSPC/bound failures return to design. Detach but retain the failed backing image/partial inputs on the runner until runner teardown; upload bounded receipts, not the bulk image.
volume.cleanup_time: Reserve60 seconds inside the2400-second controller budget for detach; earlier work stops at2340 seconds.

signing.mode: Explicit ad-hoc, no entitlements/hardened runtime/identity/timestamp. Preserve pre-explicit-sign and post-sign hashes; Go linker may already have supplied a signature, so pre-sign does not assert signature absence.
signing.static_only: codesign strict verify/display/entitlements and go version -m read the file; never invoke ipsw, including --version.
signing.binary_limit: Compile child RLIMIT_FSIZE soft=hard=2GiB limits each intermediate file; ad-hoc-sign stays soft=hard=128MiB. Produced ipsw must be a regular file <=128MiB immediately after compile, before hash/metadata/signing/export. These are configured limits, not kernel readback. The volume bounds aggregate logical capacity; outside-volume writes remain unclaimed.

import_closure: Python standard library, the source-only static_imports.py checker and exact unchanged a303 diagnostic.py for bounded authenticated GitHub no-follow reads only. No full-component/provider/FFI imports.
later_component: Separate source change binds retained post-sign SHA/version/build strings, not upstream release pin. One separately frozen arm64 two-context attempt while artifact retained, zero retries; trace remains an outcome to verify.
not_claimed: release feature equivalence; closed-source sandbox features absent
